title: Agnostic Smoothed Online Regression with Adversarial Responses
abstract: arXiv:2609.32478v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study smoothed online prediction with bounded adversarial responses. This widely studied framework bridges i.i.d. sampling and adversarial covariate selection through a smoothness parameter $\textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}}$, which bounds conditional covariate densities relative to a fixed, unknown base measure. We propose Hedge-Cover, an information-theoretic algorithm that achieves sublinear regret $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{\text{Pdim}(\mathcal{F}) \textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}} T})$ for function classes with bounded pseudo-dimension. The algorithm aggregates a carefully constructed family of experts using Hedge, with a prior that links regret to the number of disagreements between a consistent selector and a target function. We bound this number by exploiting covariate smoothness. translated_title: 具有对抗性响应的不可知平滑在线回归
translated_abstract: 我们研究具有有界对抗响应的平滑在线预测问题。这一被广泛研究的框架通过平滑参数 $\textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}}$ 在独立同分布采样与对抗性协变量选择之间架起桥梁，该参数以固定但未知的基准测度为参照，约束条件协变量密度。我们提出了 Hedge-Cover，这是一种信息论算法，对于伪维度有界的函数类，能够实现次线性遗憾 $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{\text{Pdim}(\mathcal{F}) \textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}} T})$。该算法使用 Hedge 聚合一个精心构建的专家族，其先验将遗憾与一致性选择器与目标函数之间的分歧次数联系起来。我们通过利用协变量平滑性来界定这一分歧次数。这回答了先前文献中提出的关于平滑在线回归问题极小极大最优自适应遗憾的开放问题。
tldr: 本文提出 Hedge-Cover 算法，利用协变量平滑性界定专家先验中的分歧次数，为具有有界对抗响应的不可知平滑在线回归实现了 $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{\text{Pdim}(\mathcal{F}) \textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}} T})$ 的次线性遗憾，从而解决了极小极大最优自适应遗憾这一开放问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Hedge-Cover algorithm, which achieves sublinear regret $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{\text{Pdim}(\mathcal{F}) \textsf{C}_{\textsf{cov}} T})$ for agnostic smoothed online regression with bounded adversarial responses by exploiting covariate smoothness to bound disagreement counts in the expert prior, thereby resolving an open problem on minimax optimal adaptive regret.
